research_questions.title: Recommendation relevance
research_questions.question: Does the complete DhakaNest framework improve rental recommendation relevance compared with predefined area-first and simpler recommendation approaches?
research_questions.objective: Measure end-to-end ranking quality under a common frozen candidate universe and independently annotated relevance labels.
statistical_analysis: Holm adjustment within the RQ1 comparison family
research_questions.answerability: Answerable only after complete listing fixtures, route matrices, independent labels, and all baseline outputs are frozen.

research_questions.title: Multi-destination awareness
research_questions.question: How much do destination awareness, destination importance, and maximum-commute constraints contribute to recommendation quality?
research_questions.objective: Isolate route-aware location scoring, destination importance, and hard commute constraints while holding all other inputs fixed.
statistical_analysis: Holm adjustment within the RQ2 family
research_questions.answerability: Answerable only for profiles with frozen valid routes; effects of destination count require sufficient one-, two-, and three-destination strata.

research_questions.title: User decision quality
research_questions.question: Does destination-first rental discovery improve users' ability to identify suitable homes compared with area-first rental discovery?
research_questions.objective: Compare objective housing-selection outcomes and user experience under controlled area-first and destination-first interfaces.
research_questions.answerability: Requires ethics approval, informed consent, an a priori sample-size analysis, matched tasks, and independently judged outcomes.

research_questions.title: Component contributions
research_questions.question: What are the individual contributions of KNN selection, WSM ranking, Rent Fairness, amenities, and floor-size matching?
research_questions.objective: Estimate controlled component effects without presenting the resulting variants as production methods.
research_questions.answerability: Requires precomputed outputs from the exact ablation definitions and enough profiles on which each removed component is active.

research_questions.title: Robustness and generalization
research_questions.question: How stable are recommendations across tenant requirements, areas, budgets, routing conditions, and candidate-pool compositions?
research_questions.objective: Quantify ranking stability and subgroup performance under prespecified, realistic perturbations.
research_questions.answerability: Generalization claims are limited to represented Dhaka regions, property sources, and perturbation ranges.

research_questions.title: XGBoost reliability and interpretation
research_questions.question: How reliable and interpretable is the selected XGBoost rent model across rent, size, and geographic segments?
research_questions.objective: Audit frozen predictions, residuals, subgroup error, feature influence, fallback behavior, and uncertainty limitations without reusing test data for selection.
research_questions.answerability: Historical test performance is answerable from frozen evidence; calibration, temporal generalization, and SHAP require additional compatible evidence and dependencies.
